Papirus Office is a complete, lightweight, and professional office productivity suite. Designed for high performance even on low-end devices, it supports open standard formats natively.
Papirus Office uses premium modular components for high compatibility, rendering, and layout precision:
Inky Module (Writer): OpenDocument Text (ODT) and OOXML (.docx) editor with live rich styling.
Cellina Module (Spreadsheets): OpenDocument Spreadsheet (DS) and OOXML (.xlsx) calculations with interactive cell formulas.
Slidia Module (Presentations): OpenDocument Presentation (ODP) and OOXML (.pptx) presentation deck renderer.
Pagella Module (PDF/Forms): Compact high-precision PDF document viewer and form filler.
HarfBuzz Integration: Professional advanced font and text shaping engine.
TinyXML Parser: Lightweight C++ XML parser optimized for memory-constrained environments.
This suite builds on top of LibreOffice SDK, Microsoft OpenXML specifications, and ECMA-376 standards. Licensed under GNU LGPL v3 and Mozilla Public License 2.0.
Designed with care by an Open-source and AI Enthusiast
